name: Infrastructure: action timeout
description: Playwright could not complete an action in time: slow network or late element. Retried once in CI.

name: Infrastructure: network or browser failure
messageRegex: (?s).*(net::ERR_|ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|Target page, context or browser has been closed).*

name: Product defect
description: An assertion failed: the application behaved differently from what the test expects.

name: Test defect
description: Unexpected exception in test or framework code (not an assertion).
